title: Patriots QB Drake Maye on Mike Vrabel amid controversy: 'A great human being'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Patriots QB Drake Maye on Mike Vrabel amid controversy: 'A great human being'
sources.description: New England Patriots QB Drake Maye said head coach Mike Vrabel is "a great human being" and doesn't expect the off-the-field news to be a distraction.
